title: Graph neural networks and the energetic cavity method for combinatorial optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.07456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the use of graph neural networks (GNNs) for finding approximate ground states of Ising models. Efficiently finding these ground states is of broad significance because many combinatorial optimization problems can be formulated as an Ising model with the appropriate choice of couplings and fields. Exactly solving these problems is hard but there are many good heuristic methods. A lineage of these heuristics build from mean-field approximations: one approach uses the leading eigenvector of an appropriately defined matrix, another is the min-sum algorithm, also known as the energetic cavity method. Without modification, GNNs perform worse than both of these methods. We consider small modifications to the GNN to incorporate these heuristics and find that this considerably improves performance. translated_title: 图神经网络与能量腔方法用于组合优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了使用图神经网络（GNN）来寻找伊辛模型近似基态的问题。高效地找到这些基态具有广泛的重要意义，因为通过适当选择耦合和场，许多组合优化问题都可以被表述为伊辛模型。精确求解这些问题非常困难，但已有许多优秀的启发式方法。这些启发式方法中的一类建立在平均场近似之上：其中一种方法使用适当定义矩阵的主特征向量，另一种是最小和算法，也称为能量腔方法。未经修改的GNN在这两种方法面前表现更差。我们考虑对GNN进行微小的修改以融入这些启发式方法，发现这能显著提升性能。尽管修改后的方法与其他深度学习方法相比具有竞争力，我们仍然发现模拟退火方法至少能够可靠地保持……
tldr: 通过对图神经网络进行微小修改以融入经典平均场启发式方法（主特征向量法与能量腔/最小和算法），可显著提升其在求解伊辛模型基态及组合优化问题上的性能。
en_tdlr: Small modifications that incorporate classical mean-field heuristics—the leading eigenvector method and the energetic cavity (min-sum) method—into graph neural networks considerably improve their performance in finding approximate ground states of Ising models for combinatorial optimization.
